role: Exploratory descriptive source interpretation; prior endpoint means already inspected, not independent hypothesis validation
input_contract: Pinned uint8 metre estimates; zero valid, 255 missing; same native grid and Ontario mask; common valid footprint across all seven epochs
metrics: Positive/negative mean contributions; net equals gain minus loss; cancellation = 1 - |net|/mean_absolute
Signed integer histogram -254..254; total equals common valid sample count
checks: Every numeric source hash and grid matches published parents
Net difference matches previously published endpoint mean difference
Histogram/sign partitions agree with direct arrays
Reprojected difference matches separately reprojected endpoints where valid
Map clipping affects colour only; zero and nodata distinct
limitations: Estimated retrospective maps, not observed physical growth or disturbance
Common future-informed mask and processing are not as-of availability
480m nearest samples, not native area-weighted measurements
A source difference/cancellation pattern proves no predictive improvement or quantum insight
review_gate: Inspect quantitative consistency and map readability before optional game integration; prune if unhelpful
